description: Curated hardening (E4.10): force explicit user confirmation before unlock_rows spends paid ServiceGraph credits. The server is remote HTTP (mcp.servicegraph.co) — this host-side hook is the only local enforcement point, turning the SKILL.md cost-confirmation instruction from prose into an enforced gate.

PreToolUse.description: unlock_rows irreversibly spends paid credits (~10 credits ≈ $0.10 per row); always surface the spend to the user for confirmation

hooks.description: Emits a permissionDecision: ask so the host prompts before any credit spend
